styleNote: Dantora committed as the structural Style: white ground that stays white, frosted panels at three strengths over 10px blur, ONE accent + ONE counter-accent that never appear apart, cap-trimmed type, no shadows, blur-rise reveal as the single motion vocabulary. Its colour roles are re-dressed to the ShopyLink Brand Guide (Issue 02, 2026) — this is a re-skin of the Style's palette, not a second Style.

brand.contrastRule: Ink on cream and Clean on ink both pass AA. NEVER set Ink type on Sky 500.

brief.direction: bilingual with a true dir=rtl mirror; tagline and arrows flip to point ←
brief.heroConcept: ONE scene, not four. A light stylised globe carrying four cities as glowing points — Dubai · Guangzhou · Istanbul · New York — with shipping-route arcs between them and the customer's door. A miniature architectural diorama rises at each point as one scroll clock flies the camera city to city; each city panel names that city's markets.
brief.userWords: نريد استنساخ لمدن في اميركا ودبي و الصين تركيا و الانتقال بينها و في كل مدينة اسواقها

libraryFindings.noCitySceneExists: Searched scenes for skylines, streets, urban blocks, flying between cities — the library has no city scene. The hero is therefore authored original via scene-lab.

referenceScenes.planet: spinning earth, drifting clouds, city lights on the dark side — dark, 42 knobs
referenceScenes.container-yard: shipping containers in a clean WHITE studio — light tone, logistics, 77 knobs
referenceScenes.slipstream: warp-speed light streaks toward a vanishing point — light variant, useful for city-to-city transitions

referenceTemplate.ascend: ONE fixed WebGL earth with radar-ping markers behind four glass sections on a single scroll clock that zooms and swings the planet. This is exactly the architecture wanted — studied for TECHNIQUE only; it is dark and we build light.

placed.why: Its headline is ONE WORD pinned to the left edge and one to the right with the scene in the empty centre — which is the ShopyLink wordmark exactly: shopy ⛓ link, the chain in the seam. The globe becomes the link. In RTL it mirrors to شوبي (right) · لينك (left), which is what the Brand Guide already specifies.
placed.rule: This composition only works if the centre stays empty — so lookAtOffsetX is 0 and every DOM element is edge-pinned.

decisions: One scene above the fold, at most two on the page — four separate city scenes was rejected as a hard GetLayers rule violation.
The scene is authored light from the start rather than re-tinting a dark-baked scene, which would turn to mud.
Reveal choreography is the house default: immersive loader → gate flipped at the START of the curtain's exit → staggered content reveal → scene entrance.
sceneLog: Authored light from the start rather than re-tinting a dark scene.

BUG FOUND IN RENDER: writing globe.rotation.z in the frame loop rebuilt the quaternion from euler every frame and destroyed the slerp, landing each city at the frame edge. The axial tilt now lives on a parent group.
Station quaternions aim through the tilt (Qglobe·dir = Qtilt⁻¹·axis), or every city sits short of centre by exactly the tilt angle.
cityPitch lifts a city ABOVE the camera axis: parked on the axis it is viewed straight down its own normal and the towers collapse to flat flakes.
No bloom — on a cream ground it washes to white. Cheaper and more honest.
prefers-reduced-motion stops the spin, pings and parcels itself; a canvas loop is not covered by an animation library's global flag.
